thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: GPU pool eu-west-2 saturated — autoscaler failing to scale past configured limit (scaleup_failed: limit_reached). Queue > 12k. Paging on-call @alex. Link: https://redwood/status/incident/2991234567

alex: Investigating. Saw a huge burst from tenant 'sparkloop' around 23:40 UTC, many long-running requests. Taking initial triage.

maria: Can you paste autoscaler logs? I'm seeing repeated provider 429s and `scaleup_failed: limit_reached` in controller logs.

alex: Logs: `controller: attempted_scale_to=72 result=failed reason=provider_quota_exceeded`

ops_lead: If provider quota is the bottleneck we should divert traffic to a cheaper fallback model in eu-west-1 and apply tenant-level concurrency limits.

alex: I'll create a route override now to spill traffic from sparkloop to fallback_small_model.

alex: Command: `redctl route set --from pool:eu-west-2 --to model:fallback-small --filter tenant:sparkloop`

sre-bot: Route update succeeded for tenant=sparkloop. Applying concurrency limit: `tenant.sparkloop.max_concurrency=2`.

jmorris: Quick customer impact check — were users receiving 503s or only elevated latency?

alex: Both. We saw ~2k 503s during the peak window (majority retried). Platform p50/p95 latency for gen endpoints increased ~20-30% for ~18 minutes.

maria: Mitigations in flight: spillover routing + tenant throttling. Queue reduced from 12k -> 3.2k after these actions. Autoscaler still reports limit_reached. Opened provider ticket for quota bump.

ops_lead: Approving temporary soft-cap increase to 80 nodes for eu-west-2 for 2 hours. Request infra to apply change.

infra-bot: Pool update: eu-west-2 max_nodes set to 80 (applied) — requested by ops_lead.

alex: New nodes are provisioning; monitoring for evictions during boot. Goal: queue < 500 to mark mitigated.

maria: Short-term action items: 1) add hard alarms for autoscaler scale_limit events; 2) implement early per-tenant fairness throttles; 3) schedule postmortem and customer-impact summary.

jmorris: I'll own the postmortem and the customer communication. Also proposing an admission control RFC to prevent long-running batch jobs from hitting serving pools.

alex: :thumbsup: moving to monitoring channel. If queue spikes again, escalate to oncall lead.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — queue < 500, routing stable. Incident flagged for postmortem and follow-ups (ticket #12345 opened with provider).
